description: The payload is written into the initial 1,024 bytes at the start of the Ext2 image. This region is reserved for a bootloader and precedes the primary filesystem structures, so regular filesystem metadata and file contents remain unchanged when the area is repurposed.
plaintext_preview: HIDDEN DATA HIDDEN DATA HIDDEN DATA ...
notes: Bootloader area spans bytes 0–1023 from the image start.
This method intentionally avoids modifying in-file data or core filesystem metadata.
